name: @edgegamers/spectatehub
description: Spectate hub for CS2: new joiners start in spectate, an auto camera cuts between players and fixed shots, and a click menu picks who to watch or which team to join.

spectateOnJoin.description: Put new joiners in spectate instead of on a team

disableTeamSelectMenu.description: Set sv_disable_teamselect_menu 1 so the stock team menu never opens

openOnSpectate.description: Open the hub menu when a player joins spectate

cutSeconds.description: How long the auto camera stays on a player

fixedSeconds.description: How long the auto camera holds a fixed shot

fixedShots.description: Cut to fixed map shots between players (needs the CS2 custom camera)

joinT.description: Label of the join-T button; empty hides it

joinCT.description: Label of the join-CT button; empty hides it
